title: PHYRD: A Living Benchmark for Reproducing and Extending Theoretical Physics Research
abstract: arXiv:2610.32575v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models and agents have shown significant power in advanced physical research. In this paper, We introduce PHYRD, a living benchmark for theoretical-physics reasoning with 63 Reproduce and 43 Discover problems. Reproduce tests derivation of published results; Discover tests consequences of modified theoretical conditions. FormulaForest constructs the tasks with reference solutions and subquestion-level rubrics. Across five models, whole-problem accuracy ranges from 49.21% to 68.25% on Reproduce and from 18.60% to 74.42% on closed-book Discover. With tools, four models complete more Discover problems, but conceptual errors and missing arguments persist. Besides, our experimental results demonstrate the value of FormulaForest as synthetic data. On FrontierScience, a benchmark developed by OpenAI, it raises the accuracy of a Qwen-35B-A3B model from 61% to 72%.

translated_title: PHYRD：一个用于复现和拓展理论物理研究的动态基准
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型与智能体在高级物理研究中已展现出强大能力。本文提出PHYRD，一个用于理论物理推理的动态基准，包含63个“复现”问题和43个“发现”问题。“复现”任务测试模型对已发表结果的推导能力；“发现”任务测试模型在修改理论条件后的推论能力。FormulaForest通过参考答案和子问题级评分标准来构建这些任务。在五个模型的测试中，整题准确率在“复现”任务上介于49.21%至68.25%之间，在闭卷“发现”任务上介于18.60%至74.42%之间。借助工具，四个模型能完成更多“发现”问题，但概念错误和论证缺失依然存在。此外，实验结果证明了FormulaForest作为合成数据的价值：在OpenAI开发的FrontierScience基准上，它将Qwen-35B-A3B模型的准确率从61%提升至72%。
tldr: 本文提出PHYRD动态基准（含63个复现题与43个发现题）及FormulaForest任务构建框架，用于评估大语言模型的理论物理推理能力，并证明FormulaForest作为合成数据可将模型在FrontierScience基准上的准确率从61%提升至72%。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PHYRD, a living benchmark with 63 Reproduce and 43 Discover problems for evaluating LLMs' theoretical physics reasoning, and demonstrates that FormulaForest, when used as synthetic data, boosts a Qwen model's accuracy on the FrontierScience benchmark from 61% to 72%.
